verdict.rationale: First-party docs list LLM-as-judge as an evaluator type for scoring performance on datasets and experiments. They also describe reference-free LLM-as-judge evaluators that run automatically on production traces, with filters and sampling rates to control cost. Missing for 10: no documentation of what is configurable in the judge itself (prompt or rubric, judge model choice, score schema or criteria), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the LLM-as-judge workflow.
